patch_summary: Added build_stream_findings() to vulnclaw/cli/_helpers.py which returns [] for non-list verified_claims (int count from AgentState.get_summary, missing key, garbage) and maps claim-dict lists to TUI findings as before; both --stream epilogues in vulnclaw/cli/main.py (run, solve) now call it instead of slicing the summary value directly. New tests/cli/test_stream_claims_count.py covers int-count, zero, list, and missing/garbage shapes. Full-suite caveat: any test requiring asyncio.run fails in this sandbox (loopback sockets blocked, PermissionError 10013), including the pre-existing test_run_stream_emits_progress_and_verified_claims which failed identically on the unmodified tree; remaining failures are pre-existing/environmental, none caused by this patch.
root_cause: Type contract mismatch: AgentState.get_summary() reports verified_claims as an int count, while the run/solve --stream epilogues treated it as a list of claim dicts and sliced it ((... or [])[:50]), raising TypeError: 'int' object is not subscriptable on any successful run before emit_complete_event().
